meta.title: CARE Core - The Open Healthcare OS Layer
meta.description: CARE Core is the open, MIT-licensed, FHIR R5-aligned operating layer for healthcare: shared primitives, APIs, role-based access, audit trails, forms, encounters, orders, labs, pharmacy, billing, analytics, and plugin-ready workflows.
meta.ogDescription: The stable standards-based core behind CARE: primitives, APIs, workflows, plugins, and AI-ready health data infrastructure.
meta.twitterDescription: Open, standards-based healthcare infrastructure for hospitals, public health programs, and care coordination.

structuredData.description: CARE Core is the open, MIT-licensed, FHIR R5-aligned operating layer for healthcare workflows across hospitals, public health programs, and care coordination.
featureList: Patients, facilities, users, roles, and access control
Encounters, observations, clinical documentation, orders, and reports
Questionnaires, configurable forms, terminology bindings, and APIs
Labs, pharmacy, inventory, billing, scheduling, and analytics workflows
Plugin-ready integrations for AI, TeleICU, devices, messaging, claims, and national rails
Self-hostable deployment models with audit trails and standards-aligned data

hero.title: The open healthcare OS starts with Core.
hero.body: CARE Core is the stable, standards-based operating layer behind CARE: shared healthcare primitives, APIs, permissions, audit trails, modules, and plugin surfaces that let many solutions run on one trusted foundation.

architecture.title: A kernel for healthcare workflows.
architecture.body: CARE Core keeps the primitives stable so hospitals, public health programs, implementation partners, and AI tools can build on the same record, the same permissions, and the same integration surface.

sharedCore.title: Stable shared core
sharedCore.text: Patients, facilities, providers, encounters, observations, orders, forms, tasks, care plans, reports, roles, and audit trails live in one reusable foundation.

workflows.title: Configurable workflows
workflows.text: Programs can model clinical and operational workflows through questionnaires, forms, terminology bindings, and deployment-specific configuration.

plugins.title: Plugin-ready surface
plugins.text: Apps and integrations add AI scribe, TeleICU, devices, labs, pharmacy, billing, messaging, claims, analytics, and national rails without fragmenting the core.

primitives.title: Reusable building blocks, not one-off screens.
primitives.body: Each CARE deployment can look different at the workflow layer while sharing the same data model, access model, audit trail, and API surface underneath.

demos.title: The Core becomes visible where work happens.
demos.body: CARE Core is not a blank data platform. It ships with real clinical, operational, and financial workflows that can be composed into HMIS, EMR, care coordination, and public health deployments.

dataCapture.title: Clinical data capture
dataCapture.text: Structured forms, observations, notes, terminology, and clinical context captured inside the longitudinal record.

emrForms.title: Configurable EMR forms
emrForms.text: Program and hospital teams can shape workflows without turning every deployment into a new product fork.

labs.title: Lab management
labs.text: Orders, samples, diagnostic reports, values, units, and results flow back into the same patient timeline.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy and inventory
pharmacy.text: Prescriptions connect to dispense, stock movement, substitutions, alerts, procurement, and inventory visibility.

billing.title: Billing and accounting
billing.text: Invoices, payments, claims, coverage, scheme support, and reconciliation stay connected to real care activity.

reports.title: Dynamic reports
reports.text: Clinical and operational reports are generated from the same structured workflows, not rebuilt in spreadsheets later.

plugins.title: Keep the foundation stable. Let solutions move faster.
plugins.body: CARE Apps extend the platform for AI documentation, TeleICU, devices, messaging, claims, analytics, terminology, national rails, and deployment-specific workflows. The result is reuse without lock-in, and extension without fragmentation.

standards.title: Designed for interoperability before the first integration.
standards.body: CARE Core models healthcare data and workflows around open standards, open APIs, configurable terminology, and deployment patterns that institutions can own.

deployment.title: Built for institutions that need ownership.
deployment.body: CARE Core is open-source and self-hostable. Governments, hospitals, and implementation partners can deploy it locally, integrate it with their ecosystem, and keep improving the shared core.

sovereign.title: Sovereign hosting
sovereign.text: Deploy in a government cloud, hospital VPC, managed cloud, hybrid model, or on-prem environment.

mobile.title: Mobile-first care
mobile.text: Support wards, clinics, home visits, field teams, and frontline workflows from the same platform primitives.

aiReady.title: AI-ready records
aiReady.text: Assistive AI works best when patient context, forms, encounters, permissions, and audit trails already exist.

stewardship.title: Open healthcare infrastructure needs more than code.
stewardship.body: OHC Foundation stewards CARE Core so it can serve as durable public-good infrastructure: release discipline, security, documentation, standards alignment, implementation guidance, contributor pathways, and a neutral home for governments, hospitals, funders, developers, and implementation partners.

final.title: One open foundation. Many healthcare systems.
final.body: Use CARE Core to deploy hospital systems, critical care networks, palliative care grids, clinic workflows, public health programs, and AI-assisted healthcare tools without starting from scratch.
